article.headline: Cornell defeats Morgan State 84-63
article.description: — Anthony Nimani’s 17 points helped Cornell defeat Morgan State 84-63 on Saturday.

categories.description: Cornell Big Red @ Morgan State Bears

event.description: Cornell Big Red @ Morgan State Bears

keywords: Cornell Big Red @ Morgan State Bears
article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Anthony Nimani’s 17 points helped Cornell defeat Morgan State 84-63 on Saturday. Nimani went 7 of 12 from the field (2 for 5 from 3-point range) for the Big Red (3-3). Mateen Rafiq scored 14 points, shooting 4 for 10 from beyond the arc. Mikehi Williams shot 4 for 6, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points. Alfred Worrell Jr. led the Bears (4-3) in scoring, finishing with 28 points. Ibi Traore added 16 points and nine rebounds for Morgan State. Jeremiah Kwarteng also had eight points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
